name: Flotsam
description: Flotsam was the third planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Flotsam was a barren world with no moons. An asteroid field of the star system lay before Flotsam.
lead_paragraphs: Flotsam was the third planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Flotsam was a barren world with no moons. An asteroid field of the star system lay before Flotsam.
